notes.title: AI Learns to Drive - Changelog 0.9.5 (200% Performance Boost & Determinism)
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pFeGXVg.png[/img]

This update introduces physics engine changes, focusing on performance and determinism.

[b]⚡ Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Partially multi-threaded physics updates.
[*] Rewrote Godot's raycasting system from scratch (testers estimate 100-300% performance improvements)
[/list]

[b]⚙️ Determinism[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in the first generation, newly created cars, the wheel sensor, and after pausing the simulation.
[*] Improved determinism to ~99% (collisions remain non-deterministic).
[/list]

[b]🔧 Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Maximum Parallelism" setting to control thread count.
[*] Increased default max population to 800 (up to 3000).
[*] Added a "Lap Time" reward (set this to -100% if you want fast lap times)
[/list]

[b]🖼️ UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Standardized terminology (e.g., "Score" is now "Distance").
[*] Fixed lap time rounding issues.
[/list]

notes.title: AI Learns to Drive - Changelog 0.9.1 (New Vehicles)
notes.content:
[url=https://ai-learns-to-drive.fandom.com/wiki/Vehicles][img]https://i.imgur.com/J4HPrFu.png[/img][/url]

[h2]🚗 NEW VEHICLES[/h2]
Added 3 new vehicles with different properties and handling:
[list]
    [*][b]Rally Car:[/b] Excels on dirt with 4WD for better drift control, decent on other surfaces
    [*][b]Snowmobile:[/b] Dominates on ice but struggles on asphalt
    [*][b]Truck:[/b] A heavy vehicle that is slow to turn and hard to stop
    [*][i]More info about vehicles is available on the [url=https://ai-learns-to-drive.fandom.com/wiki/Vehicles]wiki[/url][/i]
[/list]

[h2]🏆 CAMPAIGN IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Network Updates:[/b] Updated default networks (Rhino, Cheetah, Polar, Turtle) with new vehicle assignments
    [*][b]Challenge Updates:[/b] Rebalanced some challenges for new vehicle speeds. [i]Further rebalancing and more B-series tracks are coming soon[/i]
[/list]

[h2]📚 NEW WIKI GUIDE[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b][url=https://ai-learns-to-drive.fandom.com/wiki/Training_Strategies]Training Strategies[/url]:[/b] New wiki guide with four distinct strategies for evolving your AI:
    [list]
        [*][b]Starter Strategy:[/b] A simple approach for easy tracks, ideal for beginners
        [*][b]Selective Breeder:[/b] Manually select promising cars to guide evolution
        [*][b]Improved Starter:[/b] An advanced strategy for better performance on harder tracks
        [*][b]Endurance Trainer:[/b] A long-term method for steady improvement on difficult tracks
    [/list]
[/list]

[h2]🎨 VISUAL & 🎵 AUDIO IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
    [*][b]Vehicle Icons:[/b] Displayed in selection menus and leaderboards [i]now with color[/i]
    [*][b]Engine Sounds:[/b] Added custom engine sounds for each new vehicle
    [*][b]Collision Effects:[/b] Improved collision sound and particle effects
[/list]

notes.title: AI Learns to Drive - Changelog 0.4.2 (Weights Edit, Window Options, Steam Cloud)
notes.content:
[list]
    [*][b]Manual Weight & Bias Editing:[/b] Fine-tune your AI by directly editing neural network weights and biases. Simply click on them to adjust!
    [*][b]Network Editor Overhaul:[/b] Improved user experience in the network editor, fixed inverted weight colors (red, green)
    [*][b]Expanded Window Settings:[/b] Added resolution options and borderless window mode (should resolve resize-related crashes).
    [*][b]UI Scaling:[/b] UI now scales for better visibility on larger screens.
    [*][b]Dynamic Backgrounds:[/b] Replaced the static background with dynamic backgrounds that adapt to the average color of the track tiles.
    [*][b][Experimental] Simulation Accuracy Option:[/b] Boost FPS during training by reducing the accuracy of neural network updates. For optimal performance during evaluation, set accuracy to 100%.
    [*][b][Experimental] Maximum Population:[/b] Raise the maximum population number up to 1000 (works best with reduced accuracy).
    [*][b]Steam Auto-Cloud Support:[/b] Automatically sync your custom tracks and neural networks between devices via Steam Cloud.
[/list]

notes.title: AI Learns to Drive - Changelog 0.4.1 (Auto-Save & Idle Elimination)
notes.content:
[list]
    [*] [b]Auto-Save:[/b] Optional auto-save feature saves best cars after each generation.
    [*] [b]Idle Elimination:[/b] [i]Option[/i] to automatically eliminate cars idle for >8s.
    [*] [b]Direction Sensor:[/b] New sensor outputs 1, 0, or -1 indicating forward, stationary, or reverse movement [i]along the track[/i].
    [*] [b]Fixed: Precise Time Sync:[/b] Times now synchronized to 1/10th second, fixing rounding errors.
    [*] [b]Control Panel Shortcuts:[/b] Added shortcuts for play/pause, skip, etc.
[/list]
